summary: The strict Patch evidence contract materially improved semantic yield: seven of thirteen new edges were accepted, three were pending, and three were rejected. However, the UBO repair remained structure-blocked and two known qualifier/source issues remained, so mandatory gates were not yet satisfied.

primary_results.result: 7 accepted, 3 pending, 3 rejected out of 13 new edges
primary_results.details: No unknown relation types remained. All three pending edges belonged to the UBO supplement, which did not create a directed entry-process-exit path in the existing card.
Continuous monitoring, predefined-standard reference, can-help identification, CDD reference, funds legitimacy, and customer segmentation were all answer eligible.
CH47 scenario-setting REFERENCES historical experience remained a minimal accepted open relation.
